question:
Identify the word that can replace the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.

The explorer discovered a hiddden cave deep in the heart of the jungle.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"hiddden"** is incorrect. It should be **"hidden"** which means something that is kept out of sight; concealed. (छिपा हुआ)

 
 
• **Example: **The treasure was hidden under the old oak tree.
 
 
 
• **"Hidden"** refers to something that is not visible or not easily found. (छिपा हुआ)
 
 
• **Example: **There was a hidden message in the letter.
